title: Dubipapel store release
description: Visual identity and product photography direction for Dubipapel, a Chilean specialty art supply brand offering curated watercolor papers, acrylic pencils, and fine art stationery. The project covered logo system, product visual standards, and e-commerce photography art direction.
challenge: Dubipapel needed to differentiate in a market dominated by international brands with established prestige. As a local Chilean brand, the challenge was building perceived quality and trust from scratch — through design alone.
solution: Developed a restrained, elegant identity drawing from art supply aesthetics: clean white space, precise typography, and photography that celebrates material texture. The logo system balances artisan character with the clarity needed for digital retail environments.
result: Dubipapel's e-commerce conversion rate increased by 45% in the quarter following the visual refresh. The brand has since expanded to 3 new retail stockists in Santiago.
